== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[A Jedi's Fury]]: the region (108, 780, 716, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[A Jedi's Fury]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif Holotable commit efc26cd] (2024-12-29). The matching before crop is [[:File:V21-L-ajedisfury-2024-12-29-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[A Jedi's Fury]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif commit 04fafe9]) and [[A Jedi's Fury]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif commit efc26cd]).
